quiz_title: Module 13 Quiz — Identity, Windows Endpoint & Workstation Hardening

quiz_title: Module 13 Quiz — Identity, Windows Endpoint & Workstation Hardening
question_text: What is the primary security purpose of UAC when an administrative action is requested?

explanation: UAC helps control elevation from a standard context to an administrative one.

question_text: A user needs to install one approved driver. Which action best preserves least privilege?
option_a: Permanently add the user to Administrators

quiz_title: Module 13 Quiz — Identity, Windows Endpoint & Workstation Hardening
question_text: A user accesses a folder through a network share. Which permission layers may both affect effective access?

option_a: Grant Full Control to each user
